request.subject: UNIT:GOBLIN:CATAPULT

layers.text: Style: bold chibi pixel art for a playful turn-based strategy board game, a board game come to life: chunky simple shapes, flat colours with one shadow tone, low detail, clean readable silhouette that reads at a glance at small size, slightly silly and cheerful.
layers.negative: photorealism, painterly brushwork, gradients, dithering, noise, tiny details, thin outline, low-poly 3D, faceted polygons, blur, text, letters, numbers, logo, UI, frame, health bar, selection ring, cropped subject

layers.text: Camera: consistent strategy-game camera, three-quarter view looking slightly down, the subject faces down and to the right (south-east), whole subject visible and centred on a transparent background, nothing cropped. The subject stands directly on the empty transparent background: nothing at all is drawn under it.

Faction: rowdy, ramshackle scrap-heap storybook, loud and silly, never grim. Everything is made of dented riveted scrap iron plates, patched cloth and soot-black leather straps, with bolts, small spikes, square stitched patches and soot smudges as details; iron is shaded with darker blue-grey, leather with charcoal grey, cloth with a deeper tone of its own colour, never brown.
layers.negative: gun, rifle, pistol, musket, cannon, modern car, rubber tyres, chrome, headlights, neon, glowing green, lime green, cyan glow, purple magic glow, skull, bones, blood, gore, horror, wood, timber, planks, brown boots, brown leather, brown cloth, tan, bronze, copper, rust, orange rust, dark brown shading, red-brown, maroon

layers.text: Class: one chunky cute unit figure with a big head, short sturdy body and one oversized signature weapon or tool, thick single-colour black outline, standing ready pose, both feet visible; the feet are the lowest thing in the image.
layers.negative: pedestal, base, plinth, round base, disc, rim, ground plate, platform, stand, terrain slab, dirt slab, grass square, stone block under the subject, isometric block, ground tile, grass, soil, scenery, background, cast shadow on the ground, multiple units, crowd

layers.text: Team colour: large solid bright red (#d8262c) areas are the maskable owner colour and must be clearly visible from a distance, about a quarter to a third of the subject. No other red or red-brown anywhere: every other material, and its shading, uses colours that are clearly not red or red-brown.

Subject: Rocket Cart, a chunky cute rickety two-wheeled iron cart, clearly bigger than a soldier, filling the whole width of the image: a crooked frame of dented dark gunmetal plates and bolts on two big spiked dark iron wheels, carrying one huge fat bright red rocket tilted up at forty-five degrees and pointing forward, with a light grey pointed nose cone, light grey tail fins and a short cream fuse with a small pale yellow-white spark at its tail; a tiny goblin with yellow-olive green skin, long pointed ears and a bright red bandana crouches behind the cart covering its ears; simple shapes and very few details; the wheels are the lowest thing in the image; clearly a rocket launcher, not a catapult.

The tiny goblin crew wears a charcoal grey tunic with only a small red bandana, and crouches clearly apart from the rocket, behind the rear wheel, with a gap of empty space between them, so the big red rocket stays one separate shape. Every bright red garment or painted part is plain flat bright red with a slightly darker red shadow; its patches are the same bright red with thin black stitches, never dark spots. The spark is tiny and pale yellow-white, never orange.
layers.negative: catapult arm, bucket, rope, horse, flames, smoke trail, explosion, wood, wooden cart, brown cart, orange spark, red tunic, armour
